ed bottleneck/issue
Proposed action
Demand
Lack of appropriate IFA need forecasting
• Standardized demand forecasting based on accurate
estimates of district needs and previous consumption
• Computerization
and
clear
documentation
of
inventory, stock requests, and expiry dates
• Estimates to include lactating women population; IFA
distribution and counseling standard
Supply acquision & utilization
Late supplier deliveries resulting in inconsistent supply
• Implement centralized supply system whose policy is
to deduct payment upon late delivery, damaged
stock, etc.
Perceived or actual inability to procure IFA when needed
through local purchasing
• Set aside and explore use of untied funds to purchase
IFA locally in times of shortage or emergency
Lack of buffer stock use at all levels
• Implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of existing
buffer stock requirements
• Ensure adequate storage facilities so stock can be
stored safely
No safe disposal plan for expired medicines and pushing
of expiring drugs to patients and frontline workers
• Transparent plan to prevent expired medicines through
appropriate purchasing practices and safe disposal of
expired medicines
Inconsistent training on IFA counseling/distribution
across FLW types
• IFA counseling/distribution training for all frontline
workers who work with pregnant women
• Training for all frontline workers together at health
sub-center level to improve coordination and
communication
Storage
Storeroom transiency and disorder
• Construct, purchase, or long-term rental of adequate
storerooms, including resources for racks, labels, and
shelves in resource development proposals
• Training for storekeepers including storeroom order
and inventory protocols
